name: antenna_ball
theme: a ladybug's antenna-tip sphere becomes a whole planet, then the descent lands back in the meadow it came from
style_suffix: sunny macro photography, dewdrops and soft bokeh, hyperdetailed, cinematic

registers.name: meadow
registers.scene: seen low at eye level among wildflower stems in a sunlit meadow, petals and grass towering overhead, gold pollen drifting in slanted afternoon light, dew beaded on nearby leaves
registers.target: a round red ladybug perched on a broad green leaf, its lacquered shell catching the light, neat black spots dotting its domed back
registers.loop_target: the sunlit wildflower meadow, seen low at eye level among the stems

registers.name: ladybug
registers.scene: a red ladybug's domed shell fills the view, scarlet lacquer scattered with round black spots, faint reflections of sky and leaf caught on its polished curve
registers.target: the ladybug's head, a small glossy black dome with faceted eyes and two slender segmented antennae rising from it

registers.name: ladybug_head
registers.scene: a ladybug's head fills the view, a glossy black dome with faceted eyes, two slender segmented antennae arcing upward, fine dark hairs along each segment, a thread of daylight sliding along the curves
registers.target: the tip of one antenna, a small flawless black sphere, a single bead of light caught on its polished skin

registers.name: antenna_sphere
registers.palette: glossy black and dew silver, blooming into deep blue-green
registers.scene: a flawless glossy black sphere fills the entire view, one bead of light glinting on its curved skin, the meadow and pale sky mirrored and curved across its polished surface

registers.name: planet
registers.scene: a vast glossy blue-green planet fills all of space, its curved limb gleaming like wet lacquer, swirling white bands of cloud crossing oceans and continents, the black of space beyond
registers.target: a gap in the banded clouds below, sunlit gold-green countryside visible through the opening

registers.name: sky_clouds
registers.palette: sunlit cloud white and warm gold
registers.scene: billowing white clouds tower on either side, warm gold light pouring through the gaps onto rolling green and gold countryside below
registers.target: a single flowering treetop canopy rising from the countryside, blossoms and leaves bright in the sun

registers.name: canopy
registers.scene: a sunlit flowering treetop canopy seen from above, blossoms nodding and leaves humming with insects in the warm breeze, a bright clearing visible below through a gap in the branches

music_theme: A serene, floating melody that swells with each new world, blending ethereal synths and soft orchestral strings, with a single warm bloom of sound landing on the antenna-to-planet seam.
